init.path_policy: Rejects --renpy-game-dir outside --project-root; writes generated contract and initial manifest under project root/game dir only after confinement check.

new-title.project_selection: explicit --renpy-projects-root + title/slug create a project root; no cwd fallback
new-title.path_policy: Creates a title-scoped project under --renpy-projects-root and Obsidian root under --obsidian-vault/<slug>/VN; refuses non-empty roots without --force; runs project-confined validate/roadmap/scene-state/obsidian-audit before success.

check.path_policy: Reads selected project game directory and manifest only after contract confinement.

gaps.path_policy: Reads game/manifest under project; --json-out is resolved through resolve_project_path.

validate.path_policy: Validates automation docs under selected project after contract confinement.

normalize-lifecycle.path_policy: Reads/writes only the contract-selected manifest_path and confines optional --json-out under project root.

sync.path_policy: Writes extracted/resolved request batch summaries under project; --out-summary is project-confined. Obsidian vault reads are an intentional external input from contract/CLI.

queue.path_policy: Resolved-request glob is relative/no-parent-traversal; matches and --out-md/--out-json are project-confined.

generate.path_policy: Resolved-request glob is relative/no-parent-traversal; matches and --out/default output are project-confined. Runner commands are explicit operator-provided generation tools.

promote.path_policy: Metadata, candidate source, QA report, destination, manifest, and promotion log are project/game confined.

verify.path_policy: Reads contract-configured runtime dependencies after project path confinement; external ComfyUI/workflow endpoints are intentional configured dependencies.

preflight.path_policy: Checks project-local game/manifest sidecars and validates workflow_index under workflow_pack_root and title-scoped Obsidian roots.

polish-scene.project_selection: explicit --project-root/--contract via centralized project path builder
polish-scene.path_policy: Requires before/after script paths under project root, writes guard and QA report under docs/validation/<patch_id>, runs scene-guard/validate/obsidian-audit/optional RenPy lint, optionally runs validate-scene from a project-confined capture plan, then scene-state writeback and scene-state --check-existing with scene_local_preview_only and permanent_asset_changes=false. Runtime contact sheets are linked as capture_sheets when produced; static capture validation reports are linked as supplemental QA.

validate-scene.path_policy: Capture plan and output dir are project-confined; scene/capture names, legacy file:line warps, label-based warps, waits, offsets, bounded pre-capture menu actions, expected menu-choice checks, and runtime phases are bounded.

capture-scene.path_policy: Capture plan and screenshot outputs are project-confined; legacy file:line and label-based warps resolve through project-confined script files; pre-capture menu actions are bounded and whitelisted; runtime dependencies fail structured when unavailable.

scene-guard.path_policy: Before/after scripts and guard output are project-confined; start/end labels and required labels/jumps/vars/menu choices are safe identifiers or explicit values used only for deterministic RenPy slice inspection.

scene-intent.project_selection: explicit --project-root/--contract via centralized project path builder
scene-intent.path_policy: Requires safe scene_id/intent_id and an existing start label; writes project-confined scene intent JSON/Markdown under docs/automation/scene_intents/<scene_id>/, copies game/script.rpy to docs/validation/<intent_id>/script_before.rpy, optionally writes a project-confined capture_plan.json, and never modifies game scripts or asset directories.

scene-state.path_policy: Writes state/patch/pool under docs/automation/scene_remaster; changed files, QA/guard reports, capture sheets, and candidate paths are project-confined. --check-existing validates existing state links and preview-only safety flags without writing.

stack-doctor.project_selection: not project-scoped; operator supplies or defaults explicit shared infrastructure roots/endpoints
stack-doctor.path_policy: Read-only readiness check for Hermes CLI, ComfyUI endpoints, Obsidian roots, and optional workflow/output roots. Optional JSON report is operator-selected and should be written to an explicit diagnostics location.

obsidian-audit.path_policy: Audits title-scoped Obsidian active-state/dashboard/current-state semantic consistency, scene-label note drift, optional writeback manifest coverage, optional readable-index coverage, and machine dashboard active block updates; report output is project-confined.

director.path_policy: Director UX uses explicit project root and scope guards around promotion metadata; Telegram media cache is an intentional Hermes external delivery cache, not a project sidecar.

obsidian-summarize.path_policy: Generates reader-facing Obsidian indexes only under the title-scoped obsidian_project_root and writes a project-confined JSON summary under docs/automation.

roadmap.path_policy: Validates a project-confined production cockpit roadmap JSON; evidence paths must stay under the selected project and exist, outputs stay project-confined, and active Obsidian note links are checked as explicit external title-root references.
